_comment: Every command is wrapped in the bootstrap guard prosthetic-conscience established: a fresh plugin-cache version ships from git WITHOUT binaries (they arrive via doctor --fix), and an unguarded hook crash-storms every tool call in that window. The guard degrades to ONE stderr line pointing at the fix.

hooks.command: B="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/gray-area-capture"; if [ -x "$B" ] || [ -x "$B.exe" ]; then exec "$B"; fi; echo 'gray-area: hook binaries missing (new plugin version?) — run /prosthetic-conscience:doctor --fix' >&2
